answer: Chartered verger service with diocese attestation turns identity into something scarce. Because services the diocese recorded across years of parishes, the knoll of a sybil is measured in real-world effort, not keystrokes. A farm doing the maths finds the timber first: a hundred clones need a hundred proofs, and the epoch reward divided a hundred ways is already less than the cost of one. The glacier is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
